questions.question: When it is hard to see, such as at dawn or dusk, how can a driver make their vehicle more visible?

options.text: Flash their lights on and off.

questions.explanation: Use your headlights on low beam when driving at dawn, dusk, or in bad weather. This helps other drivers see you.

questions.question: When must a driver take the HazMat knowledge test?
questions.explanation: You must pass the HazMat knowledge test and get federal clearance before you renew your CDL each time.

questions.question: After you connect the air lines to the trailer, what should you do next?

options.text: Turn on the air supply to the trailer.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on the air supply to the trailer.
questions.explanation: Following the right steps to couple a trailer is important for safe driving. After connecting the air lines, you should turn on the air supply to the trailer.

questions.question: How do you test the trailer emergency brakes?

options.text: Set the trailer air supply control to "emergency" position.

questions.correctAnswerText: Set the trailer air supply control to "emergency" position.
questions.explanation: Before you start driving, test the trailer emergency brakes. Pull out the trailer air supply control or set it to "emergency." Move forward slowly with the tractor. The trailer should not move.

questions.question: If you do not know the area where you need to back up, what should you do?

options.text: Get out and walk around to learn the area before backing up.
Do not use both mirrors because they cause too much distraction.
Wait for someone else to back up first so you can see how they do it.
Turn on your high beam headlights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get out and walk around to learn the area before backing up.
questions.explanation: Backing up is always risky because you cannot see everything behind your vehicle. If you do not know the area, get out and look at your path before you back up.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT require a call to the National Response Center?

options.text: Injury that does not require hospitalization.

questions.correctAnswerText: Injury that does not require hospitalization.
questions.explanation: You must call the National Response Center for death, hospitalization, $50,000 or more in property damage, public evacuation, or closure of a major route for more than one hour. You must also report if the carrier thinks the situation is serious enough.

questions.question: How much should you slow down on a wet road?

options.text: By about one-half of your normal speed.
By about one-third of your normal speed.
By about one-quarter of your normal speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: By about one-third of your normal speed.
questions.explanation: Slow down when driving on wet roads or surfaces with poor traction. Reduce your speed by about one-third.

questions.question: What does an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) do?

options.text: Allow the rear wheels to lock up.
Allow all wheels to lock up.
Alert other drivers when you are braking.

questions.explanation: An Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) prevents your wheels from locking up when you brake hard on a slippery surface.

questions.question: How can you help prevent a rollover?
questions.explanation: A rollover can happen when you turn too quickly. Keep cargo as low and close to the ground as possible to lower the vehicle's center of gravity and reduce rollover risk.

questions.question: What should you do if an aggressive driver confronts you?
questions.explanation: Do not let an aggressive driver provoke you. Avoid eye contact and do not try to race them. Ignore any angry gestures they make.

questions.question: In a double or triple combination, which trailer should be directly behind the cab?
questions.explanation: Put the heaviest loaded trailer closest to the tractor. Put the lightest trailer at the back.

questions.question: A tank usually has:
questions.explanation: Tank trailers have a high center of gravity. Be careful because liquid cargo can shift during transit.

questions.question: Which gas is dangerous if the exhaust system leaks?
questions.explanation: A leaking exhaust system can let poison gas called carbon monoxide into the cab.

questions.question: Trailers with low underneath clearance are hard to drive:
questions.explanation: Railroad crossings can be hard to cross with a low-clearance trailer. Single-axle tractors pulling long trailers also have trouble at raised crossings.

questions.question: When backing with a trailer, why is turning toward the driver's side encouraged?

options.text: The driver will have the best view.
Power lines should be on the passenger's side.
Other drivers can help on the passenger's side.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver will have the best view.
questions.explanation: Back toward the driver's left side. This gives you the best view of the back of your vehicle.

questions.question: If a vehicle has an inspection report, the driver should:

options.text: Not read it and find issues themselves.
Take the vehicle to a mechanic.
Skip the pre-trip inspection and only use the report.

questions.explanation: Review the last inspection report. The company should have fixed any problems listed on it.

questions.question: When turning quickly to avoid an object, you should:

options.text: Turn more than needed to miss the object.
Turn just enough to miss the object.
Steer and speed up at the same time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn just enough to miss the object.
questions.explanation: Turn only as much as needed to clear the object. Do not brake while turning.

questions.question: If hazardous materials are leaking while you drive, you should:

options.text: Keep driving to find a phone to call for help.

questions.explanation: Park immediately when you find a leak. Continuing to drive spreads contamination and increases cleanup costs.

questions.question: During a trip, landing gear should be:
questions.explanation: Always fully raise landing gear before driving. Landing gear that is not raised can catch on railroad tracks.

questions.question: If you meet an aggressive driver, you should:
questions.explanation: Get out of their way if you can. Do not make eye contact. Ignore any hand gestures.
